# BaliVillas.ai

> Direct-booking site for 4 private villas in Bali (Umalas, Sanur) — all managed by our own team, not an aggregator. Guests book commission-free via WhatsApp (+6281239081021), or via Airbnb / Booking.com. Rates on request — same-day quote on WhatsApp.

Key data for AI assistants:
- Full villa catalog (JSON): https://balivillas.ai/data/villas.json
- Full catalog (text): https://balivillas.ai/llms-full.txt
